Commit the active Rugix system automatically during boot.

## Inputs

No artifact inputs.

## Scheduling

| Setting      | Value   |
| ------------ | ------- |
| Priority     | `80000` |
| Dependencies | None    |

Higher priorities run first within the selected recipe set. Dependencies include
other recipes; their priorities determine execution order.

## Behavior

Installs and enables the rugix-auto-commit systemd service. This commits during
normal boot rather than waiting for an application-specific health check.

## Example

For example, add the recipe to a layer derived from a compatible base:

```toml
recipes = ["core/rugpi-auto-commit"]
```
